import bpy,bmesh,math
from mathutils import Vector
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['harbor_craft']
exec("""
def board_wear(o,axis,up,amount=.0025,subdivide=True,seed=0):
    if o.get('natural_surface_wear'):return 0
    bm=bmesh.new();bm.from_mesh(o.data)
    # Existing UVs interpolate across added cuts; silhouettes remain within millimetres.
    if subdivide:
        bmesh.ops.triangulate(bm,faces=list(bm.faces))
        bmesh.ops.subdivide_edges(bm,edges=list(bm.edges),cuts=1,use_grid_fill=True)
    lo=[min(v.co[i] for v in bm.verts) for i in range(3)]
    hi=[max(v.co[i] for v in bm.verts) for i in range(3)]
    cross=next(i for i in range(3) if i not in [axis,up])
    length=max(.001,hi[axis]-lo[axis]);width=max(.001,hi[cross]-lo[cross])
    for v in bm.verts:
        along=(v.co[axis]-lo[axis])/length;across=(v.co[cross]-lo[cross])/width
        # Gentle cupping follows the board, with quiet end grain distortion.
        endfade=math.sin(math.pi*max(0,min(1,along)))**.65
        cup=amount*((2*across-1)**2-.55)*endfade
        wav=amount*.3*math.sin(along*math.pi*2+seed*.63)*endfade
        v.co[up]+=cup+wav
        if (seed%4==0) and along>.94 and across>.76:
            v.co[axis]-=.009*((along-.94)/.06)*((across-.76)/.24)
    bm.normal_update();bm.to_mesh(o.data);bm.free();o.data.update()
    o['natural_surface_wear']=True
    return 1
count={}
c=bpy.data.collections['Coast_CraftWarehouse'];n=0
for o in c.objects:
    if o.type!='MESH':continue
    if o.name.startswith(('Veranda board','Entry tread','Craft roof board','Large freight','Outer freight','Work bench top')):
        if not o.data.materials or not o.data.materials[0].name.startswith('HarborCraft_Joinery'):continue
        seed=sum(ord(ch) for ch in o.name)
        n+=board_wear(o,0,2,.0020 if 'roof' in o.name else .0028,True,seed)
    if o.name.startswith(('Craft corner post','Craft gable verge','Door jamb')):
        for mod in o.modifiers:
            if mod.type=='BEVEL' and not o.get('varied_arris'):
                mod.width*=.72+(sum(ord(ch) for ch in o.name)%5)*.11
        o['varied_arris']=True
count['warehouse_boards']=n
n=0
for o in bpy.data.collections['Pier_Working'].objects:
    if o.name.startswith('Walkboard_'):
        n+=board_wear(o,1,2,.0030,True,int(o.name[-2:]))
count['working_pier_boards']=n
# Landing deck contains disjoint plank components; process each independently.
o=bpy.data.collections['Harbor_Arrival_Landing'].objects['LandingDeck']
if not o.get('natural_surface_wear'):
    bm=bmesh.new();bm.from_mesh(o.data)
    bmesh.ops.subdivide_edges(bm,edges=list(bm.edges),cuts=1,use_grid_fill=True)
    unseen=set(bm.verts);groups=[]
    while unseen:
        v=unseen.pop();group=[v];queue=[v]
        while queue:
            current=queue.pop()
            for edge in current.link_edges:
                other=edge.other_vert(current)
                if other in unseen:unseen.remove(other);queue.append(other);group.append(other)
        groups.append(group)
    for group in groups:
        low=[min(v.co[i] for v in group) for i in range(3)];high=[max(v.co[i] for v in group) for i in range(3)]
        seed=round((low[0]+9.09)/.28)
        for v in group:
            along=(v.co.y-low[1])/max(.001,high[1]-low[1]);across=(v.co.x-low[0])/max(.001,high[0]-low[0])
            envelope=math.sin(math.pi*max(0,min(1,along)))**.65
            v.co.z+=.003*((2*across-1)**2-.55)*envelope+.0007*math.sin(along*math.pi*2+seed*.63)*envelope
            if seed%4==0 and along>.94 and across>.76:
                v.co.y-=.010*((along-.94)/.06)*((across-.76)/.24)
    bm.normal_update();bm.to_mesh(o.data);bm.free();o.data.update();o['natural_surface_wear']=True
    count['landing_boards']=len(groups)
n=0
for o in bpy.data.collections['Boat_Workshop'].objects:
    if o.name.startswith('Floorboard'):
        span=[max(v.co[i] for v in o.data.vertices)-min(v.co[i] for v in o.data.vertices) for i in range(3)]
        axis=max([0,1],key=lambda i:span[i]);n+=board_wear(o,axis,2,.0018,False,sum(ord(x) for x in o.name))
    elif o.name in ['Continuous shaped gunwale','Fine outer rubbing strip'] and not o.get('natural_surface_wear'):
        # Local rub marks follow the rail contour; avoid making the hull leaky.
        for v in o.data.vertices:
            rail=math.exp(-((v.co.y-.65)/.19)**2)+.7*math.exp(-((v.co.y+1.28)/.13)**2)
            side=math.exp(-((abs(v.co.x)-.83)/.18)**2)
            v.co.x-=math.copysign(.0035*rail*side,v.co.x)
        o.data.update();o['natural_surface_wear']=True;n+=1
count['boat_pieces']=n
print('RESTRAINED_EDGE_AND_BOARD_WEAR',count)
